title: Fortune: Formula-Driven Reinforcement Learning for LLM Reasoning over Complex Tables
abstract: arXiv:2505.23667v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Tables are a fundamental medium for organizing and analyzing data, making table reasoning an essential capability for intelligent systems. Although large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong general reasoning abilities, they still struggle with accurate numerical reasoning over tabular data, particularly in complex table settings that require more than simple relational lookup. Spreadsheet formulas provide a powerful and expressive interface for executable symbolic operations, enabling sophisticated reasoning patterns that remain largely underexplored by existing LLMs. In this paper, we introduce Formula Tuning (Fortune), a formula-driven reinforcement learning (RL) framework that trains LLMs to generate executable spreadsheet formulas for question answering over tabular data, using execution success and answer correctness as reward signals. translated_title: Fortune：面向大语言模型复杂表格推理的公式驱动强化学习
translated_abstract: 表格是组织和分析数据的基本媒介，因此表格推理是智能系统的一项核心能力。尽管大语言模型（LLM）展现出强大的通用推理能力，但在对表格数据进行精确数值推理时仍存在困难，尤其是在需要超越简单关系查询的复杂表格场景中。电子表格公式为可执行的符号运算提供了强大且富有表现力的接口，能够支持复杂的推理模式，而这在很大程度上尚未被现有LLM充分挖掘。本文提出了公式调优，这是一个公式驱动的强化学习（RL）框架，通过以执行成功和答案正确性作为奖励信号，训练LLM生成可执行的电子表格公式来回答表格数据相关的问题。基于Fortune，我们训练了Formula-R1，并在七个表格推理（基准）上评估其性能。
tldr: 提出Fortune，一种公式驱动的强化学习框架，以执行成功与答案正确性作为奖励，训练大语言模型生成可执行的电子表格公式，从而提升其在复杂表格上的数值推理能力。
